CatalogueAct.description: One watched act: the watchlist's names for it, and where this site shows it.

aliases.description: Other names the watchlist gives the act.
aliases.title: Aliases

domain.description: The watchlist's sector for the act, or ''.
domain.title: Domain

events.description: Entry key to its event page, for every committed entry.
events.title: Events

feed.description: The act's Atom feed, by the same rule; null when the build wrote no feeds.
feed.title: Feed

key.description: The act's key within its corpus.
key.title: Key

provisions.description: Canonical top-level location to its provision page, for every location a committed change names.
provisions.title: Provisions

url.description: The act's page: absolute with a site URL, else root-relative.
url.title: Url

waiting.description: Consolidations announced for the act and still waiting for a text, as the poller's own record held them at build time, oldest first; empty when nothing waits or the build was handed no record.
waiting.title: Waiting

CatalogueWaiting.description: One consolidation the poller was told about and could not read yet, at build time.

first_seen.description: The day the poller first saw it; null when its record holds no date.
first_seen.title: First Seen

state.description: `consolidation_pending` while the text is not published yet, or `english_unavailable` when no English text is offered.
state.title: State

version.description: The consolidated version announced; null when it is not yet known.
version.title: Version

CatalogueWaiting.title: CatalogueWaiting

description: Every watched act, quiet ones included, sorted by corpus and key.

checked_through.description: The end of the last window the poller read, from its own record at build time: changes published up to this day were looked for. Null when the build was handed no record or the poller has never closed a window.
checked_through.title: Checked Through

disclaimer.default: Not legal advice: this output is machine-computed from published texts, carries no lawyer's review, and is engineering assistance only.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

provenance.default: Derived by the site build from the watchlist and the committed changelogs; not part of the record.
